rachel (PM): Quick triage 1: milestone window is slipping due to a KV regression and a spike of enterprise asks for tenant isolation. I propose a clear two-track plan: ship a "guardrail MVP" that guarantees latency/SLOs, and commit to a discrete v1 for multitenancy and analytics. MVP (guardrail): SSO + billing events + compact promptstore (single-tenant admin + CSV import/export). v1: multi-tenant routing, per-tenant QoS, analytics and webhooks.

diego (Eng): Agree on carving scope. Two immediate questions: 1) are API semantics changing between MVP and v1? 2) do we pause promptstore feature parity now?

rachel (PM): Answers: 1) API surface will be backwards-compatible; we'll avoid adding route-level semantics that assume multitenancy. 2) Pause advanced promptstore features (replication, tenant isolation) until v1. Keep CRUD + export/import.

priya (Infra): Multi-tenant routing requires changing our KV partition and cache invalidation model. Estimate: 4 full infra days + 2 days of e2e. Risk to 99.9th is material if we push it. Recommend deploying a conservative global limiter for GA. Example limiter we can ship immediately: {"global_rps":"650","per_key_rps":"300","burst_ms":"1000","fallback_model":"rwd-small"}.

samir (Design): UX compromise: surface a clear "Single-tenant GA mode" badge in the admin console and add a simple tenant dropdown for the compact promptstore. Ill mock the flows and the customer-facing copy to reduce support confusion.

vela (Sales): Two deals require tenant isolation. Sales will accept GA if we: A) provide a one-page customer note that says GA = single-tenant + SSO and B) commit to a v1 target window (two sprints after GA) and include an option for an interim beta toggle for key accounts. Legal needs that language for contracts.

diego (Eng): Billing and quota are the other gating items. We need a stable billing event envelope and a deployable quota gate before freeze. Otherwise finance & operations will push back.

priya (Infra): We can ship the quota gate and an event-envelope spec within 48 hours if we reallocate two infra cycles. Also can add a runtime feature-flag so Sales can trial a "beta-tenant" with a flip in infra for a small set of customers.

rachel (PM): Proposed acceptance criteria for the guardrail MVP:
- SSO (Okta/Google) for admin and API issuance
- Billing events emitted for every request with agreed envelope
- Compact promptstore: single-tenant admin CRUD + CSV import/export only
- Conservative global rate limiter enabled by default
- Canary rollout + health probes and documented rollback plan
- Customer note draft for Sales/Legal with v1 target window and beta-toggle option
If anyone has a blocker to this set, flag now.

qa-bot: ci-bot: Canary pipeline queued: milestone-guardrail/mvp (ci#14200) :rocket:

diego (Eng): If infra delivers gate + event spec by EOD Wed, Eng will freeze the trimmed surface and move owners to harden telemetry and error-handling. Otherwise we keep original scope and move GA.

vela (Sales): Please add "expected v1 date" in the note. Sales will not promise GA without that clarity. Also request a short FAQ for support about rate limits and "why my tenant needs to wait".

rachel (PM): Will draft the customer note and FAQ, add an explicit v1 sprint window, and tag Legal. Ill publish the updated roadmap and PRD entry if no objections by EOD. :thumbsup:
